name: Gemma 4 31B

architecture.layer_mix: sliding-window attention with periodic full-attention layers (see config.json layer_types)

summary: Largest Gemma 4: dense 30.7B, 256K context. About 19-20 GB at 4-bit, which fills a 24 GB card; every weight is read per token, so it is slower than the 26B-A4B.

practical_baseline.reason: No reported or measured run is recorded yet. The Ollama default tag is the simplest recorded path.
